about: POST /register on an open hub whose daily quota for the client's network is spent (hub-payment-privacy PAY-A1 step 4b, PAY-A3, §2.2): with a good proof of work the answer is 429 registration_quota, with Retry-After until the next UTC midnight; check_only still answers open.

cases.name: the network's places of the day are spent

body.error: Today's sign-ups from your network are used up; retry after Retry-After, or ask the operator to run anet-hub admit <AID>.

cases.name: check_only takes no place and answers open
